security.item: Log tools need permission to manage plugins; clearing or deleting log entries also needs permission to edit plugins, a POST request and a valid security token
The log is now kept in Joomla's log folder under a protected file name instead of an unprotected logs folder in the site root; logs from older versions are moved over and removed on update
Only the page path and query are logged, long addresses are shortened, and an unwritable log no longer shows PHP warnings on the site

fix.item: Fixed a fatal error on the front end of Joomla 6 when the Backward Compatibility plugin is off (GitHub issue 2)
Fixed language placeholders showing instead of text in the installer and plugin lists (GitHub issue 1)
Template CSS files are now found on Windows servers
Joomla 6 sites are now offered updates

addition.item: Rebuilt Log Viewer: light and dark mode, filters, statistics cards, plain-text dump, CSV download, delete selected, and a confirmation dialog for Clear All
Support tab and a post-install card with next steps

language.item: Added Norwegian Bokmal and Norwegian Nynorsk (17 languages) and refreshed all translations

fix.item: Fixed the Scan Templates and Log Viewer buttons not showing on the plugin settings page
